title: Setup → Positions under zh-CN lists the built-in positions in English (Platform Admin, Organization Owner, Everyone, Guest …) while the built-in permission sets are translated
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible defect, reproduced in the browser on @objectstack 18.2.0 (found in the hotclm 18.2 upgrade pass, objectstack-ai/hotclm#155), zh-CN console as the dev admin.

**Symptom.** `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/position` lists 14 positions. The app's seven render in Chinese (18.2 made position label/description translatable). The platform's own seven render label and description in English: Platform Admin, Organization Owner, Organization Admin, Organization Member, Organization External Member, Everyone, Guest (e.g. "Built-in audience anchor: every authenticated member holds this position implicitly…").

The sibling page `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/permission` renders every built-in permission set in Chinese (管理员 — 完全访问, 成员 — 标准访问, 外部成员 — 仅本人记录 …), so the bundle exists for sets and is missing for positions.

**Expected.** The built-in positions carry zh-CN (and the other shipped locales') `positions.<name>.label` / `.description` in the platform bundle, like the built-in permission sets.

**Business reason.** Setup → Positions is where a Chinese-speaking administrator assigns people; half the list, including the two audience anchors every grant is reasoned about (Everyone, Guest), is English.

**Reader.** The platform lane that owns the built-in position declarations and their translation bundle (plugin-security / platform-objects i18n).

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states, "built-in positions untranslated zh-CN": 0 direct hits; nearest #25893 (Setup pages English under zh-CN, closed, other pages), #25909 (Positions list Description column, closed).
